chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden our bones from the earth, and has forbidden worms from eating anything from our flesh.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the bodies of the Ahl al-Bayt after death?
ai.summary: This hadith states a special divine protection granted to the bodies of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام after death. It indicates their unique sanctity and honor with Allah عَزَّ وَجَلَّ.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.581 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden our bones from being consumed by the earth and has forbidden worms from eating our flesh."
